questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be filled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Rachel ______ to Paris to complete her course.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **will return**

***__Key Points__**

 
• If we look at the sentence carefully, we see that the latter part of the sentence says *"...to complete her course."*, i.e., this is the **purpose**
 
• Since the purpose (of completing her course) is yet to be fulfilled, **simple future tense **would be used, i.e., **will return**
 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• ***'returning': ***This is an example of a **gerund **here and it should be used alone. Thus this is incorrect.
 
• **'would returned': ****'Would' *is a **modal verb **that should be followed by **V1 (present) **form of the verb and not the past form. Thus this is incorrect.
 
• ***'was return': ***The **auxiliary verbs** *is/was/am/are/were, *etc. are followed by either **verb+ing **or **V3 + d/ed**. Thus this is incorrect.
 
 

**Thus the complete sentence is: ***Rachel **will return** to Paris to complete her course.*
